result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a persistent loading spinner overlapping an already loaded restaurant card image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' thumbnail image under the 'Popular right now' section, even though the image and card content have already loaded.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator state is properly cleared and hidden once the image asset finishes loading or the data fetch completes.
